entries.title: A computer that reconnects while your first mate starts again shows in reach
entries.body: When your first mate started again, after an update say, a computer that ran work and reconnected at that moment could show as out of reach in Settings → Devices, and get no work, until it dropped and reconnected. It now shows in reach and takes work as soon as it reconnects.
entries.noPicture: This changes which existing state a computer's row shows after a restart, not how any view looks.
